description: Database-agnostic data model for CRM System. SAP-compatible field types and lengths are annotated on shared objects (Accounts/Business Partners, Contacts/Business Partners, Products/Materials, Quotations/Sales Quotations, Sales Orders, Invoices/Billing Documents, Tickets/Quality Notifications, Assets/Equipment, Line Items/Document Items).

field_types.text: Variable-length long text, no length limit
field_types.currency: Decimal with 2 decimal places for monetary values
field_types.enum: Enumerated value from a defined list
field_types.reference: Foreign key reference to another object

common_fields.name: updated_by
common_fields.description: User who last updated the record

Account.description: Company or organization the business interacts with

Contact.description: Individual person the business interacts with

ContactAccount.description: Junction table linking contacts to accounts (many-to-many)

fields.name: role
fields.description: Contact's role at this account (e.g., Decision Maker, Technical Contact)

fields.name: is_primary
fields.description: Whether this is the contact's primary account

Lead.description: Potential sales prospect not yet qualified as a contact or opportunity

Opportunity.description: Sales deal tracked through a configurable pipeline

fields.name: actual_close_date
fields.description: Actual close date (when won or lost)

OpportunityContact.description: Junction table linking opportunities to contacts with roles

fields.name: role
fields.description: Contact's role in the deal (e.g., Decision Maker, Influencer, Champion)

DealRoom.description: Optional purpose-built workspace for important opportunities

fields.name: default_probability
fields.description: Default win probability for this stage (0-100)

fields.name: is_closed
fields.description: Whether this stage represents a closed deal

fields.name: is_won
fields.description: Whether this stage represents a won deal (only if is_closed)

fields.name: active
fields.description: Whether this stage is currently in use

Quotation.description: Formal price proposal sent to a customer

fields.name: total_amount
fields.description: Total quotation amount (calculated from line items)

fields.name: total_amount
fields.description: Total order amount (calculated from line items)

fields.name: total_amount
fields.description: Total invoice amount (calculated from line items)

LineItem.description: Product line item on an Opportunity, Quotation, Sales Order, or Invoice
LineItem.sap_equivalent: Sales Document Item (VBAP) / Billing Document Item (VBRP)

fields.name: alternative_to
fields.description: Item number of the line item this is an alternative to. If set, this item does not count toward the document total.

PricebookEntry.description: Price book entry defining the price for a product, optionally per customer and/or quantity range. Supports: (1) base price per product, (2) customer-specific price, (3) quantity-based pricing with either a fixed price or a discount percentage.

fields.name: account_id
fields.description: Customer-specific price. If empty, this is the general price for the product.

fields.name: price
fields.description: Fixed price for this entry. If empty, the discount_percent is applied to the product's base price.

fields.name: currency
fields.description: Currency code (ISO 4217). Required if price is set.

fields.name: quantity_from
fields.description: Minimum quantity for this price to apply (inclusive). If empty, no lower bound.

fields.name: quantity_to
fields.description: Maximum quantity for this price to apply (inclusive). If empty, no upper bound.

fields.name: discount_percent
fields.description: Discount percentage off the base price (0-100). Used when no fixed price is set for this entry.

fields.name: active
fields.description: Whether this price book entry is active

Product.description: Product or service in the catalog

Activity.description: Interaction or task (call, email, meeting, task) linked to CRM records

fields.name: is_auto_logged
fields.description: Whether this activity was automatically logged from email

Ticket.description: Service or support ticket tracking a customer issue

fields.name: contact_id
fields.description: Customer contact who reported the issue

fields.name: service_contract_id
fields.description: Active service contract covering this ticket

fields.name: assigned_to
fields.description: Support agent assigned to this ticket

fields.name: name
fields.description: Status name (e.g., New, In Progress, Resolved, Closed)

fields.name: is_closed
fields.description: Whether this status represents a closed ticket

fields.name: is_resolved
fields.description: Whether this status represents a resolved ticket

fields.name: active
fields.description: Whether this status is currently in use

SLA.description: Service Level Agreement defining response and resolution time targets

fields.name: applies_to_priorities
fields.description: Array of priority values this SLA applies to (e.g., ["High", "Critical"])

fields.name: business_hours_only
fields.description: Whether SLA timers count only business hours

fields.name: active
fields.description: Whether this SLA is currently in use

KnowledgeArticle.description: Knowledge base article with solutions and information

TicketKnowledgeArticle.description: Junction table linking tickets to knowledge articles

ServiceContract.description: Service agreement defining coverage and entitlements for a customer

fields.name: entitlements
fields.description: Description of what the contract covers

Asset.description: Installed product at a customer site

fields.name: account_id
fields.description: Customer account where the asset is installed

fields.name: functional_location
fields.description: Functional location where the equipment is installed

Document.description: File attachment linked to any CRM record

Comment.description: User comment or note on any CRM record

UserProfile.description: CRM user profile extending the authentication identity

fields.name: auth_uid
fields.description: Authentication provider UID (e.g., Firebase Auth UID)

fields.name: current_streak_days
fields.description: Current consecutive activity streak in days

fields.name: active
fields.description: Whether the user account is active

fields.name: notification_preferences
fields.description: User notification settings (which events trigger desktop/email notifications)

Role.description: User role defining permissions and UI configuration

fields.name: name
fields.description: Role name (e.g., Admin, Manager, Sales Rep, Support Agent)

fields.name: is_system_role
fields.description: Whether this is a built-in role (Admin, Manager, User)

fields.name: permissions
fields.description: Object-level permissions: { object: { create, read, read_all, update, delete } }

fields.name: ribbon_items
fields.description: Array of navigation items visible in the Ribbon for this role

fields.name: visible_cards
fields.description: Per-object configuration of which Linked Record cards are visible

fields.name: active
fields.description: Whether this role is currently in use

Team.description: Group of users under a manager

fields.name: read
fields.description: Whether the notification has been read

fields.name: link_type
fields.description: Type of record to navigate to

fields.name: link_id
fields.description: ID of record to navigate to

fields.name: send_email
fields.description: Whether an email notification should also be sent

fields.name: email_sent
fields.description: Whether the email notification was sent

fields.name: is_default
fields.description: Whether this is the user's default dashboard

fields.name: widgets
fields.description: Array of widget configurations: { type, title, position, size, config }

Badge.description: Achievement badge that users can earn

fields.name: description
fields.description: What the badge is awarded for

fields.name: criteria
fields.description: Conditions that trigger this badge: { metric, threshold, comparison }

fields.name: is_custom
fields.description: Whether this badge was created by an admin (vs. system default)

fields.name: active
fields.description: Whether this badge can still be earned

UserBadge.description: Record of a badge earned by a user

Challenge.description: AI-assigned monthly challenge for a user

fields.name: title
fields.description: Challenge title (e.g., 'Contact 5 existing customers this month')

Streak.description: Tracks consecutive-day activity streaks per user and activity type

PersonalBest.description: Tracks personal records for key performance metrics

fields.name: previous_achieved_at
fields.description: When the previous best was achieved

AuditLog.description: Tracks all record changes for undo support and audit trail

fields.name: object_type
fields.description: Type of object that was changed

fields.name: object_id
fields.description: ID of the object that was changed

fields.name: field_name
fields.description: Field that was changed (for Update actions)

fields.name: object_name
fields.description: Display name of the record at time of event

DataSourceConfig.description: Per-object configuration for the pluggable data source layer

fields.name: object_type
fields.description: CRM object type (e.g., Account, Contact, Product)

fields.name: source_type
fields.description: Where data is read from and written to

fields.name: endpoint_url
fields.description: External system endpoint URL (required if source_type is External)

fields.name: field_mapping
fields.description: Mapping between CRM fields and external system fields

fields.name: active
fields.description: Whether this data source configuration is active

AIProviderConfig.description: Configuration for the pluggable AI provider

fields.name: is_active
fields.description: Whether this is the currently active AI provider

LevelDefinition.description: Defines the gamification levels and their XP thresholds

fields.name: name
fields.description: Level display name (e.g., Rookie, Closer, Dealmaker, Legend)

fields.name: xp_threshold
fields.description: Minimum XP required to reach this level

fields.name: unlocks
fields.description: System capabilities unlocked at this level

XPEvent.description: Defines how many XP points are awarded for different CRM actions

fields.name: xp_value
fields.description: XP points awarded for this event

fields.name: active
fields.description: Whether this event currently awards XP
